payload.reason: The evidence provides specific evaluation metrics used in the study, including BLEU-4 and slot error rate (ERR), as well as manual evaluation metrics for informativeness and naturalness.

claims.text: The evaluation metrics used include BLEU-4 score and slot error rate (ERR).
Manual evaluation metrics include informativeness and naturalness, rated by human annotators.
Fleiss’ kappa was used to measure inter-rater consistency for the manual evaluation metrics.
